context: Specify a schema-versioned evidence model, fail-closed states, exact repository and PR identity, a controller-provider boundary, and fixture repositories. Consume Bossmode only through a future public JSON contract; never parse control.db. This item creates no deletion path.
description: Define the non-destructive contract for durable worktree lifecycle evidence before adding cleanup behavior. Preserve disposable linked worktrees; classify ownership and uncertainty explicitly; define structural branches and exact merged-PR evidence for develop, release, and published-results; and keep reports as timestamped snapshots rather than deletion authority. Bossmode owns task and run evidence while BenchBox owns repository policy and Git mutation.

anti_patterns.instead: Keep reporting and later mutation single-target and operator-driven

anti_patterns.dont: Treat clean, old, gone-upstream, or lease-expired state as abandonment
anti_patterns.instead: Classify uncertainty and require explicit ownership and integration evidence
anti_patterns.why: Each signal can occur while valuable work is active

anti_patterns.dont: Use source-tip ancestry to prove a squash merge
anti_patterns.instead: Match exact PR head, base, merged state, and reachable merge commit
anti_patterns.why: Squash merge does not retain source-tip ancestry

preserves.behavior: Dirty, locked, detached, missing, foreign, and ambiguous worktrees remain preserved.
No force removal, automatic unlock, prune, gc, remote deletion, PR mutation, or scheduled deletion.
The primary clone remains read-only for agent changes.
worktree-remove remains exact-path, clean-only removal that keeps the branch.
